verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an AI platform with user accounts, conversations, agents and uploaded documents, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented export capability for user data, such as conversation history, agent configs or document libraries. The open-weights and self-hosting posture concerns the portability of models, not the user's own data, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
